how: THE READING OF THE UNMARKED LINES, 2026-11-18. These lines stood under record web-wc6p2-01, verified; no sorter had marked them, so main had not read them one by one. Main read all 990 such lines of the lane against their records' grounds. Narrowed: line 39: the seat's own residual, 1.4e-11; main's is 1.1e-9 and does not beat it.
note: The parent's ground is unchanged for its other lines.
